overview: Herbert arrives in the seaside city on a long working trip. Accidentally he falls in love with a very strange beautiful saleswoman in a flower shop. He suffers from insomnia, which he treats by watching billiards on TV. But now it doesn’t help anymore. His obsessive passion keeps him awake…

title: Film Crew in Quarantine
overview: The curious routines of film set people killing time in quarantine.

title: VARTA
overview: The Hero defends his country over and over, in a timeless cycle of aggression and betrayal.

title: Promise
overview: This is a very personal story about how much everything is connected. About the relationship of children and parents, ecology education and responsibility for both relations with people and with nature.

title: O Homem das Gavetas
overview: A metaphorical approach of the seven deadly sins in the form of a man whose body is made of drawers. One day, one of his drawers opens and he begins a journey in search of a way to fill in his emptiness. An animated short film based on Salvador Dali’s ideas where the surrealist scenario meets the seven deadly sins.

title: Whence Comes the Rain
overview: This short film, animated with pencil drawings, tells the secret origin of the rain. A bird of prey has an unexpected encounter between the clouds.

title: About Love
overview: Man and Wife have been married for years. Everything is intolerably usual and suffocating routine in their cathedral of love. Something has to change. Do they realize that their cohabitation is not coincidence but God’s plan?

title: Oh No Pedro
overview: A story of a young man who has lost his words, his thoughts, and his gender identity. Those eyes are always sharp as knives, yet the secret inside him is no longer hidden, waiting to be free by himself.

title: Comendo Cérebros
overview: A girl plays in the forest of brain trees. A fruit falls into her lap and she takes it home, triggering a great family transformation.

title: Marianna's Dive
overview: Marianna is 14 years old and she has just lost her love. Shattered by an endless sadness, the kid is roaming the streets of a grey and autumnal Palermo. Meanwhile, an elusive figure is walking through the same streets, someone who seems to be interested in everything that people ignore. Can an unexpected meeting, between dream and reality, help Marianna find some trust in life again?

title: Obsolescence
overview: A consumer society buried under tons of obsolete products keeps the hopes of a few who refuse to surrender.

title: Inspiration
overview: Cigarette advertisement by Hans Fischerkoesen.

title: Sonne ins Haus!
overview: Animated advertisement for Sonne briquettes.

title: Die Kälte wich
overview: Fashion advertisement by Hans Fischerkoesen.

title: Cracks in the Pavement
overview: A beautiful and delicate flower grows in the middle of the asphalt jungle. A street rubbish bin witnesses the mistreatment of the Flower. Concerned about her torment, the rubbish bin seeks a way to protect her.

title: Eden
overview: Rufina is ready to spend a field day, surrounded by peace and pleasant nature, will it be as simple as it seems?

title: Souvenir
overview: A boy enters a world of fantasy to protect his loved one.

title: Vessel
overview: In Andreas Angelidakis' "Vessel" our screens are the vases of Ancient Greece—devices for communication, consumption, immersion and alienation. By recalling Diogenes the Cynic, who lived in a pithos with his dog and from where he denounced the wrongs of society and trolled other thinkers, the film conflates past, present and future to reflect about the material and immaterial cultures and infrastructures that shape our lives.

title: Belongings
overview: Tiny little objects that suit a certain purpose and meet other's demands were also something that had their own space and time before they became objects.

title: The Lonely Goalkeeper
overview: Legendary Arsenal goalkeeper Bob Wilson reflects on a grueling and often surreal life between the goalposts.

title: Malinchista
overview: A 2D animated short film reclaiming a Spanish slur to empower Latinx women by retelling the story of La Malinche.

title: Not for money, not for love, not for nothing
original_title: Not for money, not for love, not for nothing
overview: In the world of money and sex, this emotionally engaging documentary gives rare insight into the reflective personal struggle of sex workers. Using animation for anonymity, real questions are deliberated by real women.

title: Pink and Blue
overview: The film explores the life of a transgender man, his experiences of growing up, feeling different, as well as his story of coming out

title: The Train to Qinling
overview: A Middle-Eastern traveller gets lost on a train in China with no one else but a Panda! She must learn to communicate with him in order to find the adventure she was looking for in an unexpected way.

title: Falafel Sundays
overview: The short is about a connection to a time, food and a person who serves it. It revolves around fleeting connections and tiny interactions, that become a part of our nostalgic past.

title: For the woman on the floor
original_title: For the woman on the floor
overview: After a traumatising assault on her body, a woman hides within a quiet world of clean sheets. Ms. Yarn must reveal the pain she has buried deep within.

title: Tsui no Sora
overview: After the sudden death of a student, mysterious things start to happen and a school seemingly falls into madness.

title: A Zoo Without an Elephant
overview: In 1949, after the war, Hidé and his sister Myoko are poor and live in a makeshift hut under the bridge and do their best to survive. When Myoko recovers from an illness, he offers to take her to the Zoo to show her the impressive elephant that marked him during a visit when he was younger. He will be angry to find that there is no more elephant, replaced by a cardboard reproduction. Sankichi, a Zoo employee will tell him the sad truth about what happened.

title: Open Eyes in Shadow
overview: Opening and closing a door. Opening and closing the eyes. The lighthouses of a shadow illuminate the secret under my bed Like eyes in the shadow.

title: The Devil Had Other Plans (Act I)
original_title: The Devil Had Other Plans (Act I)
overview: A gut reaction to the Coronavirus apocalypse, made in the first weeks of isolation and confusion in March-April 2020, echoing the shocking, eerie and surreal experience of the pandemic. Reworking the classic Zombie public-domain film from 1968 'Night of the Living Dead' by a mix of deep-learning AI coloring technology, datamosh techniques, re-cutting and sound work. Visions of the invisible found in the horror film images get broken apart and reassembled to become a haunting kaleidoscopic experience.

title: Samurai Gold
original_title: 遠山桜宇宙帖・奴の名はゴールド
overview: This science-fiction anime was inspired somewhat by the life of Kinshiro Toyama (1793-1855), who was first popularized in the 1893 kabuki play "Toyama no Kinsan."

title: Shadow World
overview: A young boy decides to take on an alien invasion and rescue the world. Then he becomes a superhero to protect the world.

title: Fortune Cookie
overview: The story of a fortune cookie who has to break himself into pieces on his pursuit of happiness.

title: Crop Chasers
overview: A farmer 'hires' two scarecrows to guard his crops against voracious attacks by a flock of crows. During one attack a baby crow falls into the farmer's water well, and the scarecrows save its life. The grateful crows pledge to leave the farmer's cornfield alone in the future, and set about to repair some of the damage they have just done.

title: The Beauty
overview: What if plastic could be integrated into sea life? Take a deep breath and dive into a world, where feelings of guilt dissolve amongst the mysterious depths of the ocean. A world where we encounter bizarre creatures and discover eerily beautiful landscapes. Unfortunately, our air doesn’t last forever and we have to realize that nature alone can't solve this issue.

title: Big Game XXVIII: Road Runner vs. Coyote
original_title: Big Game XXVIII: Road Runner vs. Coyote
overview: Big Game XXVIII: Road Runner vs. Coyote is a tv special featuring four hours of Wile E. Coyote and Roadrunner cartoons, a pregame analysis by Jerry Glanville, Nick Buoniconti, Cris Collinsworth and Len Dawson, and play-by-play shots.

title: The Studio
overview: In the calm light of a studio, a man relaxes, a woman draws. They are two strangers for whom the process of creation awakens intimacy that touches their very being. For the artist it is the need to go beyond appearances; for the model it is the refusal to look at the self. From scene to scene the film progresses, transforms, reconstructs the human interior landscape. A dramatic confrontation ensues.

title: Has Anybody Seen My Umbrella?
overview: The story of a prince who leaves school after his grade one graduation thinking he knows all there is to be happy. When he has grown up he meets Cinderella at his birthday party ball, but when she loses her glass slipper he cannot read her name on it. Thinking her name is "Umbrella" he searches far and wide shouting "Has anybody seen my Umbrella". After timely intervention of the prince's fairy godmother they are united. They get married and spend their honeymoon in grade two. Based on the popular children's book Has Anybody Seen My Umbrella by Max Ferguson.

title: Alchemists
overview: This short animation is a visual fantasy, a gripping tale that is "larger-than-life" in its themes: life, death and rebirth; creation and destruction; permanence and impermanence, spontaneity and control. Bold swoops of liquid colour surge with variations on Mozart's Requiem to a startling denouement. Alchemists will provoke reflection on creativity, relationships and the environment. Without words.

title: Draw Me a Song
overview: In this charming animated short, a musician drops his son off at day care and returns home to work. Suddenly, the telephone rings. His son leaves a message on the answering machine, "I love you, Daddy." The father tries to concentrate on his composition, but the telephone rings throughout the day, the messages becoming more poignant. Touched by his child's love, the musician, at last, begins to play a beautiful melody on his clarinet. His imagination soars into the clouds and beyond, eventually gliding down to Earth on the beam of a spotlight, where he performs before a full audience. Every seat is occupied by his son, who sings along, "La, la, la, la..."

title: The Mare's Egg
overview: A pioneer's life may be a hard one, but there's no doubt that a little optimism goes a long way. Confused by advice on what to avoid when buying a horse, our gullible settler is fooled into buying a "mare's egg"--to hatch his own colt! After weeks without success, he tosses the "egg" into the bushes--with hare-raising results! But as he chases after the "hatched colt," he remembers the advice: big ears--stubborn; big teeth--a biter; low in the hindquarters--a runaway for sure. Well, maybe he's better off without this one, and off he goes on his optimistic way--with plans to save up and buy another egg! Adapted from a story by Carole Spray.

title: I'm Your Man
overview: Set to Leonard Cohen's 1988 song "I'm Your Man", this animated short offers a playful meditation on romance and the clichés that go with it.

title: Showa Shinzan
overview: This animated film tells the story of a young Japanese girl's relationship with her grandfather, a postmaster and amateur geologist. When the neighboring Mount Usu erupts during World War II, he records its activity. As he witnesses the birth of a new mountain named Showa Shinzan, he transcends the misery and folly of war that surrounds them and teaches his granddaughter a valuable lesson about life. Evoking the tradition of Bunraku puppetry, this animated film is based on actual events.

title: Rumors
overview: This short animation begins with a mysterious man lying unconscious on the ground in the middle of a bustling metropolis. A crowd of passers-by forms around him, each person attempting to guess what is going on. While the crowd's babbling feeds the rumour mill, it never occurs to any of the onlookers—not the scientist, or the cop, or the businessman, or the punk, or the old lady—to just go and help the poor guy. Rumors is a wickedly funny and biting social satire from the Groupe Kiwistiti, a Quebec-based auteur animation group.

title: Liaisons
overview: This abstract film, full of rich colours and textures, was created thanks to an inventive use of digital technology. It grew out of an unusual process of interchange between the painter Jean Detheux and the composer Jean Derome. The result is a rare meeting of images and music. What we get is an intense meditation on a world in constant renewal, where every form that emerges is immediately engulfed by the next one. It constitutes a sort of diptych with the film Rupture, which follows. A film without words.

title: Stray Dogs
overview: Plot unknown. Described as "Silence of the Lambs meets Lady and the Tramp.”

title: A Cow's Tale
overview: Does technology make our lives easier?  Audrey works away at her computer and she encounters a problem. Nothing seems to help: neither a co-worker's advice, nor the user manual, nor the help line. Stuck on hold, Audrey dreams of how simple life must have been before the age of technology.  This animated tale, with a real animal soundtrack, makes for a funny and witty dig at how little we've really evolved. A film without words.

title: Tic Tac
overview: Marc Daigle is a graduate in animation and graphic technologies from the Collège communautaire du Nouveau-Brunswick in Miramichi. He works as a graphic artist, illustrator, Web designer and animator. In 2005 he co-directed the animation Pimp ma botte, a hilarious parody of the TV program Pimp my Ride.

title: Listen, You'll See...
overview: An animation film that illustrates how closely eye and ear are linked, and how one acts on the other. The film is divided into three sections--game, conflict and flirtation--that repeat themselves without seeming to do so. This illusion is created by the sound track, which varies and colours the action. A film without words.

title: Shots in the Dark with David Godlis
original_title: Shots in the Dark with David Godlis
overview: Between 1976 and 1980, young Manhattan photographer David Godlis documents the nocturnal goings-on at the Bowery's legendary CBGB, "the undisputed birthplace of punk rock," with a vividly distinctive style of night photography.

title: Bandwidth
overview: This film combines colour, animation and sound to clarify principles of radio wave transmission. It illustrates how antennas propagate radio waves and how they may be adapted to increase the bandwidth of transmissions. (The film was released for general use as a public service by the Royal Canadian Air Force.)

title: Propagation
overview: Combining colour, animation and sound to clarify principles of radio-wave transmission, this film illustrates how antennas propagate radio waves.

title: Les Fleurs de macadam
overview: In this film, Jean-Pierre Ferland sings Les Fleurs de macadam, about the industrial workers of Montréal who are tied to the grind and grime of the city.

title: Garden
overview: A film animation experiment in metaphoric imagery. This is a surrealistic garden where the earth seethes with strange, unusual shapes and activity, accelerated in movement, compressed in time. Insect-like creatures dart under and over the sand with elusive swiftness; Picasso-like faces stare momentarily upward, mutate, and disappear; wilted blossoms become suddenly animated. What happens on the screen is punctuated and accompanied by synthetic sound effects.

title: Modulations
overview: A film of playful observation, without commentary, catching in a few simple animated line drawings the images people project of themselves in the way they dress or move. Different types of people--plump dowager, curvaceous dancer, kilted Scot, ancient Egyptian--all make their bid for attention, metamorphosing one from the other in surprising ways. Film without words.

title: Eye
overview: Eyes may be the windows of the soul, but when the gaze is directed outward they become much more than organs for perceiving the world, they become also an instrument of involvement in all of life's drama. In this highly imaginative animation film, one disembodied eye (one is all it takes) embarks on life's adventures, entering into and disengaging from all the many passions, vicissitudes and conflicts that beset one's course.

title: Just a Little Love Song
overview: This particular love song is an ironic, oftentimes caustic, commentary on the terror and pain of love, from a child's desperate attempts at closeness with his parents to an adult's relationship with a cruel and isolating world. Animated boldly with a paint brush and black ink, the action, like a continual dance, throbs to the rhythms of a five-string banjo. Shapes change, are metamorphosed, in an emotional roller-coaster trip through the subconscious.

title: Luna, Luna, Luna
overview: A child sleepwalks into the forest. A black vastness inhabited by night creatures throbs and chirps, croaks and gurgles. As she wades deeper into the shimmering night, the real forest and the imaginary one dissolve into each other. Apparitions and phantoms begin their nocturnal dance. The atmosphere becomes charged and witches come shrieking to life. When the fear of the night reaches its peak, the moon rises and the final lunacy begins. An animated film about a child's reaction to the mysteries and magic of the night. Film without words.

title: Khuda-Yana, la película
production_companies: BRB Internacional, Screen 21, TVE, Dongwoo A&E

title: Semblance
overview: The Art of Navigating Grief

title: Thorns and Fishbones
overview: Alone in the desert, three children decide to try and uncover their mysterious house's secret

title: Namahage's Obon Homecoming
overview: A visitor shows up in the middle of the night at the countryside house that Miyako shares with her father. Miyako goes to wake up her father, but the creature enters the house. Miyako stands frozen.

title: A Night in Camp Heebie Jeebie
original_title: A Night in Camp Heebie Jeebie
overview: The ghost stories shared by a gaggle of girl scouts become all too real in this slick and silly spook'em-up.

title: Blue Is Not My Favorite Color
original_title: Blue Is Not My Favorite Color
overview: A short documentary film about a family photo album that becomes an animated journey for an only-child reflecting on his parent's belief that a color could influence his gender preference.

title: Il était une fois...
overview: Short animation film.

title: Anna, Cat-And-Mouse
overview: A man spies on Anna, he breaks into her house, destroys everything that surrounds Anna, trying to take possession of her.

title: Confined Spaces
overview: An animated documentary about the space being occupied by religion in the Universe.

title: Worn Out Words
overview: Two fish, green and orange swim in a fantastic universe. The two enter into an animated pursuit generating several metamorphoses in the spaces in which they are. Each transformation represents a different phase of the relationship between the two, interpolated with excerpts from the poem.

title: Dayo
overview: A lonely man is saved by his love for his work.

title: Nada se Perde
overview: In this journey, little Emília learns with her flower that the ones we love always stay in some way.

title: First Person Shooter
overview: FPS is a shooter game in which only one bullet is fired and then you deal with the aftermath of actually shooting a human.

title: From My Desert
overview: ​Temperature: 21. Humidity: 55 %. Optimum conditions for Martin to stay fresh and presentable. Rosy skin, bedroom eyes, a naughty little cap, that’s how he meets the young art investor in the depot of an anonymous airport. His master, Lucas Cranach the Elder, created him almost five hundred years ago. Now he hangs opposite a paralysed suit rendered ecstatic by his presence. They are talking about the art market. And yet about so much more.

title: Cameras Pointed Straight into the Sun
original_title: Cameras Pointed Straight into the Sun
overview: Two criminals take a trip up the coast of California. As they arrive at a small town- what should just be a small stop on the way- one of them begins to feel as though they've been their before.

title: Star Fallen
overview: Star-Fallen is a short, sweet story about two boys who meet under the stars and fall in love as they grow old together.

title: A Storybots Halloween
overview: The StoryBots brave a castle on a dark and stormy night to understand how eyesight works. Maria Bamford guest-stars as an eccentric scientist. (The StoryBots are curious little creatures who live under our screens. The intrepid quintet of Beep, Bing, Bang, Boop and Bo of Team 341B go on an adventure to the human world to help answer kids' biggest questions.)

title: Sunny and Steve: Enjoy the Sweets
original_title: Sunny and Steve: Enjoy the Sweets
overview: A fast and funny battle of wits between a lowly office worker with a sweet tooth and a rabbit determined to protect his candy.

title: Infinite Patterns
overview: A visually poetic and compelling look at how universal geometric principles connect to nature, art, and architecture.

title: Heart of Darkness
overview: Based on Joseph Conrad's novel, Marlow, captains a leaky steamboat up the River Congo in search of a mysterious figure named Kurtz who has carved out a brutal kingdom in which he has power of life and death over his native subjects.

title: Cleaning Day
overview: A litte horror story inspired by real events from a certain shared flat I used to live in

title: Bococo
overview: Two parrots (an idiot and a clever ) are confronted with the death of their mistress on the one hand, and on the other with the fire of their apartment...

title: Alba’s Memories
overview: Alba remembers how she fell in love with Pierino, her brother's friend, in the early fifties in Italy.

title: Merlin and the Toothless Knights
overview: Animation about Merlin inventing a toothbrush and toothpaste to stop the decay affecting King Arthur's knights due to their consumption of sweet food.

title: Red Shetland
overview: An animator works on a series of scenes for a high fantasy adventure film.

title: Flip the Frog and Clarisse Cat: The Dating Game
original_title: Flip the Frog and Clarisse Cat: The Dating Game
overview: Flip tries to overcome several obstacles in order to spend the day with his girlfriend, Clarisse.

title: Flip the Frog and Clarisse Cat: Quality Time
original_title: Flip the Frog and Clarisse Cat: Quality Time
overview: Flip and Clarisse are trying to get some personal time together, but are constantly interrupted by people knocking on their door.

title: Olinda and Joaquim
overview: Guided by a written narration, Olinda and Joaquim, two fictitious elderlies, travel through everything that is happening in this last phase of their lives. Although each has its own way to deal with aging, in the end both are there to support the other until eternity, showing that being old is not as bad as it may initially appear.

title: Flip the Frog and Clarisse Cat: Snowbound
original_title: Flip the Frog and Clarisse Cat: Snowbound
overview: Flip and Clarisse go out to enjoy time at a ski resort. How does Clarisse not freeze to death considering that she doesn't wear any pants? The world may never know.

title: Sabrina: Remote Possibilities
overview: While doing some late night channel surfing, Sabrina discovers that her remote control can change her physical appearance in various ways.

title: Amy the Squirrel: A Walk in the Park
original_title: Amy the Squirrel: A Walk in the Park
overview: Amy goes out for a walk before walk while many gawkers follow her and proceed to unintentionally hurt themselves and the people around them.

title: Destined to be Dead
overview: There, where there are no tracks anymore and the fallen trees embrace the rubble, someone sits; in the Indian summer’s crispy grass, and says peace unto himself. Things felt can not be erased, but they fade into wisdom for the future. Maybe it is not earthly this road i have to walk, but how can i know if i am subjected to gravitation.

title: Is It Still Greasy?
overview: A satirical film based on the folk joke of the same name about greedy and hypocritical church servants and the gluttony of ridiculously selfish people. True to popular folklore, greed is eventually punished.

title: The Parrot Lady
overview: An enigmatic figure moves across the landscape of a seaside town. She is the Parrot Lady; an elderly homeless woman with three pet parrots tied around her finger. Inspired by a true story, 'The Parrot Lady' is an artistic contemplation on a woman's life who chose to live on the streets with her parrots, afraid of dying alone in her home.

Heik Ernitsa's directorial debut "Encounter" is a humorous story about dreams and reality. "Street" by Valter Uusberg paints a nervous and gloomy picture of the artificial environment of the city. Mati Küti's satirical "Monument" dissects egocentrism in a grotesque tone.

title: Athomic and Stouts
overview: The Stouts steal Athomic in order to use it to start a war.

title: Mountain Heart
overview: Mountain Heart explores the themes of isolation and ecological extinction through a series of oblique vignettes that build to a denouement both sad and tentatively uplifting.

title: White and Fluffy
overview: A hand drawn, synesthetic inspired animation for the track "White and Fluffy" by Floating Circles Quartet.

title: Speed
overview: First impressions are so important.

title: The Big Apple
overview: A rare fruit that keeps changing shape. Developed during the animator's first year in the city, the three-minute animation is a fluid depiction of New York's vibrancy.

title: The Last Train
overview: A diverse cross section of tired, drunk, disgruntled, joyous and riotous strangers, pushed together within the confines of the last train home.

title: The Bridge
overview: A woman slips into Alzheimer's disease and before sinking, she's holding on to the memory of a missed appointment near a covered bridge. Akin to her memory dislocated, the bridge becomes a vast mess where hope and mind are led astray.

title: Nox Insomnia
overview: A seven-year-old boy who can't sleep, thinking about his issues. He hears some disturbing noises coming from his parents' room. What could that be? A story about childhood, sex and insomnia.

title: Postpartum
overview: The film describes the chaotic phase in life of a new mother. Pumped up with hormones and lacking sleep, this intense time has burned deep into the protagonist's heart.

title: Signs
overview: An electrician follows his nightly routine setting up signs in the city. He goes through life unnoticed and out of touch with the world, until he realises which signs he should be paying attention to.

title: Rex Song
overview: A young T-Rex struggles with an identity crisis.

title: Method
overview: Square Boi wants a cup of tea and he's willing to face insanity to get it.

title: Metamorphosis
overview: A butterfly explores the ruins of an ancient civilization that leads to a underground cave. In the cave, the butterfly meets the Humanoid butterfly.
production_companies: University of Southern California, School of Cinematic Arts

title: Pirouette
overview: The very first independent film by animator Georges Schwizgebel, which was made in 1969 as an episode in the anthology film "Patchwork". Along with Schwizgebel, "Patchwork" included the talents of filmmakers Claude Luyet, Daniel Suter, Gerald Poussin and Manuel Otero. "Pirouette" combines a simple drawing of a figure with photographs, cut-outs from magazines and samples of cloth. A prominent motif of this collage mix is a drawn male face slightly inspired by pop-art.

title: Deux Oiseaux
overview: 1967. Jean, an eight-years-old city boy, spends his holidays at his grandparents' farm. He gives in candid yet cruel games on the surrounding animals. But this violence is nothing compared to what takes place in the shed, a room that Jean does not even dare entering. One day, Jean kills a tit by accident. He decides to take in the orphan hatchling to nurse him.

title: For Baby's Sake
overview: Children exposed to domestic abuse are more likely to be abusive or experience abuse in their adult relationships, creating a cycle of trauma and risks to life chances across generations. For Baby's Sake is a programme for expectant parents, who want to bring an end to domestic abuse and create the best possible start in life for their baby. The film is built from interviews with two new parents who share their experience and give the message that with the right help - change is possible. The film was made during the COVID 19 lockdown, animated on a houseboat in Wiltshire.

title: Green
overview: An unhealthy relationship between two forest beings leads Lemon Boy to reconsider his priorities for the future.

title: Them
overview: A story about a building with an inner courtyard an its inhabitants. While the different character follow their everyday routines, trash slowly begins to pile up in the courtyard.

title: Liliana
overview: Liliana is a beautiful girl and dedicated hard worker. But she does have a secret that keeps her going... A poetic narrative from another time and place with a touch of nostalgic past.

title: Liquid Solid
overview: Waves of small coloured glass pieces weave across screen. Shapes appear, merge, and disintegrate. From the chaos a form is created.

title: The Letter X
overview: The letter X in various typefaces.

title: Sex Moves
overview: A young man walks around London, asking strangers how to have sex.

title: All of Our Shadows
overview: The film follows a day in the life of a young teenage boy as he faces his fears and concerns.

title: A Half-Fledged Thing
overview: As a winged seed begins its journey in the world -- something special happens.

title: A Dog By Your Side
overview: A montage following the key stages of a woman's life with her dog always by her side.

title: The Violinist
overview: It is Singapore in the late 1930s. Kai and Fei are childhood friends and aspiring violinists. When Japan invades Malaya in 1941, Kai chooses to forgo his music career to join the anti-Japanese forces. After the war Kai goes missing. Determined to find him, Fei performs all over Southeast Asia, all the while seeking any news of Kai. Yet, as time fades, Fei has to decide if she must find her own music to define the remaining years of her life.

title: Garfield
overview: Animated feature film based on the popular comic strip about a sarcastic, lasagna-loving cat.
production_companies: Alcon Entertainment, Paws, Inc, Columbia Pictures, Sony Pictures Animation

title: Steward
overview: A meek football steward's workday goes from bad to worse as he attempts to catch a glimpse of his favorite player.

title: Wendigo
overview: A hunter returns to his cabin to discover he brought more than a trophy back with him.

title: Chakra The Invincible: The Mystery of Mighty Girl
original_title: Chakra The Invincible: The Mystery of Mighty Girl
overview: The movie features Raju Rai, a young Indian boy living in Mumbai, India. Raju's mentor, the scientist Dr. Singh, develops a technological suit that weaponizes all the Chakras in the body. Raju uses its powers to be a superhero and vows to use the suit to protect and serve Mumbai as he battles super-villains. The Invincible fights new enemies and makes a new mysterious friend Mighty Girl. But, who exactly is Mighty Girl, where did she came from and how is she going to change Chakra’s life?
production_companies: Cartoon Network Studios, Cartoon Network India, POW! Entertainment, Graphic India

title: Chloé Van Herzeele
overview: Chloé, an old lady, organizes screenings in a subterranean space. She shows to a journalist her galleries where her collection of silver films is stored. As we go down, we dive with her into her altered universe.

title: Fujiko Fujio A's Mumako
overview: OVA that is based on a manga simply titled Mumako (literally “Dream Devil Child”) written by Fujiko Fujio A.

title: The Tell-Tale Heart
original_title: Der Verrückte, das Herz und das Auge
overview: Inspired by the Edgar Allan Poe story "The Tell-Tale Heart," this is the story of Ed, a middle-aged nervous-laughing insane man who lives in his family manor, and of his plans to murder his elderly demented father and dispose of the corpse.
production_companies: Hochschule für Film und Fernsehen 'Konrad Wolf', Magnet Films

title: In the Place of Fallen Petals

title: New Moon
overview: Second in a series of paper films made from strips of color Xerography. In these films, the filmmaker is concerned with the film as an object or motion picture "soft sculpture" constructed of 16mm-sized strips. The paper (or emulsion) could be a kind of skin complete with hair and pores, half-tone dots, paper fiber - through which the world is viewed.

How can one film nothing, how to depict infinity in a film? A camera pointed towards the sky registers one such attempt. The infinite sky in the frame is seen precisely that way – like nothing, a film stripe worn out, empty surface, 0 (zero). The hand holding the camera is trying to keep the slide in the same motionless position. At one point, the camera slightly moves to the left out of fatigue. A roof with a chimney appears in the bottom left hand corner – the only part of the scene which inadvertently reveals the attempt and the wish – how to film nothing.

overview: Two prisoners are trapped in a void. Trying separately to escape, they discover each other and have to overcome their fear in order to connect and find a way out. Or do they really discover themselves? Filmmaker Greg Labute renders an austere nightmare world using the SANDDE's stereoscopic animation drawing tool and a dark, slightly perverse imagination. This film was made as part of the 6th edition of the NFB's Hothouse apprenticeship.

title: Balanços e Milkshakes
overview: A love lived by two children is remembered by a narrator.

title: Amigãozão
overview: They say that it is not right to call him a big guy, but I can't find a better way to talk about my BIGGEST friend. Sometimes big people even seem to forget that I exist, but never when he is by my side: at those times, I feel like I am the greatest!

title: planeta T E R R A / E A R T H planet
overview: Realized in 1985, this film is a Brazilian joint effort in honor of The International Year of Peace, 1986. 30 animators contributed to it, and at that time, those are almost all the Animation artists in Brazil.

title: Viagem na Chuva
overview: Rain, like the circus, travels a long way to its destination. When the two are gone, the memories remain.

title: Aquarela
overview: With a homonymous score by Toquinho, Vinicius, Morra and Fabrizio, the film makes a metaphor between life, from birth to death, and a watercolor painting that, over time, discolours.

title: Cidade Fantasma
overview: Young salaried man meets girl in summer in Porto Alegre.

title: The Man Who Got Nowhere
overview: A man that no one knows is walking in the park without getting anywhere. When the winter arrives and he dies the local government arranges a big fair in the park. The people are happy and buy things.

title: Unlaced
overview: A myopic woman walks, then boogies, through a wintry urban landscape, her world view altered suddenly by a beat from within herself, transporting her to a rich and lush place full of green foliage. Animated in stereoscopic stop-motion, Winnipeg filmmaker Megan Turnbull's film creates a magical, miniature world entirely of out paper sculpture and pure invention. This film was made as part of the 6th edition of the NFB's Hothouse apprenticeship.

title: A Pointless Whisper
overview: The Squirrel of Death has lost his queue. With it, his motivation and self esteem also disappeared. So he decides to go and look for it ...

title: Your Letter
overview: Adapted from the Webtoon with the same title.

title: Art For Lawyers
overview: They've commissioned some art. But what's it all about?  What kind of stuff do they like? Let's talk to them and find out!

title: New Year
overview: In 1999 a boy becomes obsessed with the Y2K bug; In the distant future a girl is learning to be a priest in a religion based upon the ‘artefacts’ left behind by the boy. The Year 2000 was simultaneously the beginning of the future, and the end of world.

title: Tusk
overview: A mammoth is defrosted into an unrecognisable future.

title: The Long Yourney
overview: The film is a journey through a fantastic country in which the erotic images of the films of the great Federico Fellini came to life, and Tonino Guerra himself acted as a guide. The heroes of the maestro’s paintings are sailing on a ship to the Enchanted Island. There everyone goes ashore except two - Federico Fellini and Juliet Mazina. Their wanderings continue.

title: Sun Moon Lake
overview: A long time ago, there lived the brave young man Dajian and the beautiful girl Shuishe on the treasure island of Taiwan. They loved each other and often met under the big tree. Suddenly one day, the whole earth fell into darkness. It turned out that the demon dragon living in Blackwater Pond had stolen the sun and moon.

title: Batmilk
overview: An oafish ghoul and his soft exposed brain are met with ruin when the brain is unexpectedly killed. Though paralyzed, the ghoul attains a fresh brain and is fed with new life. This film was made as part of the 5th edition of the NFB's Hothouse apprenticeship.

title: Family Album Number One
overview: A layered narrative exploring memory and family history is constructed using a collage of family photos, photocopies and personal audio recordings. The film explores the fragility of personal memory, and photos as physical tokens of that memory. This film was made as part of the 5th edition of the NFB's Hothouse apprenticeship.

title: Channel X Cartoon Show
overview: Experimental short by Robert Morgan.

title: Roy G Biv
overview: Dale Hayward brings to life his watercolour on paper. This film was made as part of the fourth edition of the NFB's Hothouse apprenticeship.

title: One
overview: This minimalist piece of animation explores the origin of life. This film was made as part of the fourth edition of the NFB's Hothouse apprenticeship.

title: Biology Made Un-easy
overview: A close look at the microscopic world that surrounds us. Within each basic human interaction there is something strange festering under the surface, and we just need a good magnifying glass and a strong stomach to see it. This film was made as part of the fourth edition of the NFB's Hothouse apprenticeship.

title: Margins
overview: This short animated film looks at the relationship between social spaces and taboos surrounding mental illness and other forms of marginalization. The film is intended as a mood piece, a chance encounter between a lone figure and an indifferent crowd. This film was made as part of the fourth edition of the NFB's Hothouse apprenticeship.

title: Cumulus
overview: A multi–layered story of an accumulation of encounters between black clouds. This film was made as part of the fourth edition of the NFB's Hothouse apprenticeship.

title: Cores Sonoras
overview: A man finds the colorful vitality of the world on music

title: Black Jack: Dr. Pinoco's Adventure
original_title: ブラック・ジャック Dr. ピノコの森の冒険
overview: Dr. Black Jack forgot his doctor's bag, and his assistant (plus self-claimed "wife") Pinoko rushed to deliver the bag but found herself lost in the forest. Guided by a butterfly, she found that many animals in the forest are sick or injured, and Pinoko used her knowledge to help those animals.

title: Go! Anpanman: Nanda and Runda from the Star of Toys
original_title: それいけ!アンパンマン おもちゃの星のナンダとルンダ
overview: The super pastry hero must help a selfish princess with a kind robot to find her missing magic wand that turns anything in its path into toys!

title: Go! Anpanman: Mija and The Lamp of Magic
original_title: それいけ! アンパンマン ミージャと魔法のランプ
overview: Creampanda and Kokin-chan picked up a mysterious lamp. What emerged from the lamp was the spirit girl Mija. The three enter the world of lamps with her magic, but the magic bracelet breaks and they cannot return to their own world. Mija and his friends work together to aim for a magical fountain to fix the bracelet. Huge enemies such as the genie of sweets and the monster of "Scary Scary Forest" stand in front of them, but they manage to overcome them. Later, Anpanman and his friends jumped into the ramp and joined Mija and others, and arrived at the magical fountain, but if they aimed at the power of the fountain, Baikinman also came.

title: Soreike! Anpanman: Ringo Bōya to Minna no Negai
original_title: それいけ!アンパンマン たのしくてあそび ママになったコキンちゃん!?

title: MILKOFFEE
overview: A diner in the middle of the desert, two strangers and a glass of latte: these are the elements of “Milkoffee”, an adaptation of one of the short stories of “Crìmenes Ejemplares”, a collection of murder chronicles by Max Aub. Told in first person, the movie tries to visually represent the frustration and inner madness of the narrator, who feels tremendously and inexplicably annoyed by the noise of the teaspoon on the glass of the other one.

title: A Cloud's Dream
overview: Watch as one cloud’s imagination soars from the familiar to the unknown on a captivating journey from dusk until dawn. Animated using partial audio waveform data, A Cloud’s Dream is a stereoscopic particle simulation that explores various cloud formations. This film was made as part of the 7th edition of the NFB's Hothouse apprenticeship.

title: Sick
overview: The body is a magnificent system. But its harmony can be interrupted, sometimes by subversive agents within. Sick uses stop motion to bring to life a knitted body in a fanciful journey through the pulsating organs and dark recesses of the human body. This film was made as part of the 7th edition of the NFB's Hothouse apprenticeship.

title: Black Gold
overview: This animated short employs hand-drawn animation layered over stop-motion sequences of moving ink on drumskins to create a striking, mournful portrait of the Alberta tar sands. This film was made as part of the 7th edition of the NFB's Hothouse apprenticeship.

title: Missed Connection
overview: In this animated short, a delusional young man spots the girl of his dreams in his favourite café and weaves a self-indulgent fantasy story of their imagined life together. Missed Connection examines our universal desire to connect in a world of beautiful strangers. This film was made as part of the 7th edition of the NFB's Hothouse apprenticeship.

title: Siren's Tail
overview: Roque was disoriented. They told him that he was a human being and that he could become a mermaid. He didn't understand why it was one thing that had to become another. Also forever! One thing or the other. Black or white. Meat or fish. Boy or girl. Human or mermaid ... As if there were only two options! Can't a decision also be that you don't want to make a decision?

title: Blinder
overview: A digitally engineered life form struggles with a belligerant operating system. In a skewed look at human/computer relations a belligerent digital light blinds our hero into desperate measures. The only way to stop the incomprehensible blinding pain is to opt for physical disablement. Meticulously hand-made on Silicon Graphics computers and Alias-Wavefront software.

title: Hell Gate
overview: Dong-hwi, who suddenly died of suffocation and went to the underworld.  The judge says, 'You killed a man, you must go to hell.'  Dong-hui goes from place to place to claim his innocence, but there are too many documents needed to prove it.

title: Scatter Brain
overview: An experimental study of the inside of a "scattered brain".

title: Niko – Beyond the Northern Lights
overview: After a tearful goodbye, Niko leaves his family behind to fulfil his biggest dream and take his place next to his father on Santa’s Flying Forces. Stella, an unknown challenger, arrives to compete for Niko’s spot. Despite their competitiveness, the pair take a liking to each other, and Niko shows Stella where Santa’s sleigh is hidden. However, on the night before Christmas Eve, Stella steals it. Gutted by Stella’s betrayal and desperate to appease his angry father, Niko heads to the frozen North to recover the sleigh. He is accompanied by his old friends Wilma and Julius.

title: The True Story of Sawney Beane
original_title: The True Story of Sawney Beane
overview: In 16th-century Scotland, young Sawney Beane yearns to itch and scratch and buccaneer. So he bids farewell to his parents and their life of honest toil.  Forty years on, Mr. Beane croaks his dying wish to Betty, his wife. "Go and find our lost son." And so Betty strikes off on her quest across the land, with the family savings in a hankie and a secret suspicion in her heart.

title: Negotiating a New Canadian Constitution
overview: A visually fascinating and mildly ironic look at the Canadian people, this three-minute film is an animated version of a poem by Lionel Kearns. It is experimental in nature and well-stocked with brilliant graphics and an unusual sound track.

title: Marching the Colours
overview: An experiment in film animation, visualizing a well-known military march in abstract, geometric patterns of colour. Bold hues move, march, blend and separate in a dynamic pattern of mobile forms, giving colour and shape to the sound patterns of the music. A film made without use of a camera. Rereleased in 1952.

title: Sailing Ship and Tree
overview: Sailboats and trees after the rising sea level flooded the continents.

title: Poison Ivy Picnic
overview: This animated film shows what happens to two picnickers who had never heard the warning 'Leaflets three--let it be.' Colour photographs of the various types of poison ivy will help others avoid their plight.

title: Keewaydah
overview: Keewaydah explores the reclamation of Indigenous storytelling, identity, culture and history through stop motion animation. Produced with the assistance of the NFB's FAP program.

title: Donald Duck's First 50 Years
overview: Includes: "The Wise Little Hen," "Donald and Pluto," "Don Donald," "Donald's Nephews," "Donald's Double Trouble," "Rugged Bear"

title: Death by Heart
overview: It is not always easy to find the right opportunity to say what you had intended to say to a friend.

title: No Words
overview: No Words is a short film about a character who is being forced, by outside sources to write a story he doesn’t want to write. He pushes back against these forces in order to be true to himself and write the words he needs to set free.

title: Chibi Godzilla's Good Cinema Etiquette
original_title: 【ちびゴジラ】ちびゴジラのえいがマナー
overview: Promotional short for following good etiquette at Toho cinemas.

title: Sonhos da Isah: O baú do papai
original_title: Sonhos da Isah: O baú do papai
overview: Ready for a time travel? Embark on this adventure!

title: Rebus Film Nr. 3
overview: Animation short film by Paul Leni.

title: Grounded
overview: A young soldier without experience is sent to a surveillance post in the middle of the desert.

title: Cracked Ice
overview: Stop Motion Animated short.

title: Cut Price Glory
overview: A LIFE Cartoon Comedy

title: Dinky Doodle in the Arctic
overview: A Walter Lantz Cartoon

title: Black Forest
overview: An upcoming stop-motion animated film by Thurop Van Orman, said to have romance, pretzels, and "wrestling wild animals".

title: Bobby Bumps' Amusement Park
overview: A Bray Studios cartoon.

title: The Big Reward
overview: An Aesop's Fable cartoon

title: Mechanical Operation of British Tanks
overview: Animated short originally presented as part of the Paramount Bray-Pictograph program

title: The Ruby of Razmataz
overview: Animated short originally presented as part of the Paramount Bray-Pictograph program.

title: The Head Saves The Earth
overview: Jim (The Head) is an animated mutant superhero with an insanely large cranium. A freak encounter left him with a problem. A big one: he’s got an alien named Roy living inside his oversized dome. Plus, he’s got the added headache of having to deal with an impending invasion of Earth by a fiendish army of evil parasitic aliens. Jim and Roy are feverishly assembling the Anti-Invasion Machine, whose live pieces have been scattered throughout the world. Will Jim and his skull-dwelling companion have the skill to save the Earth? Only The Head knows.

title: Champagne
overview: The true story of a young teenage girl whose mother is incarcerated for murder. Living in a Catholic Children's home run by an order of nuns, she provides poignant commentary about her mother, her own situation and her outlook for the future.
production_companies: Michael Sporn Animation, First Run Features

title: Shortness of Breath
overview: Approaching a Supercross competition, Thomas, a young driver, is under pressure from his father who projects great hopes in him.

title: Obverse and Reverse
overview: The other side of the picture hides a parallel world. At the same time and place, the same story happens. Two worlds are constantly intertwining and interacting with each other.

title: The Friends
overview: A group of friends is torn asunder. As told by a member of the group

title: Meta Pre Ptolemy
overview: In this whimsical animated short, filmmaker Rachel Peters asks: "what if the laws of physics suddenly ceased to apply?" Peters explores this question through the tale of a man and his two goldfish as they prepare for the end of the world. Technique: drawn animation, digitally coloured and composited. This film was made as part of the third edition of the NFB's Hothouse apprenticeship.

title: Ice Ages
overview: Seeking shelter from a thunderstorm, a man sits in a pub watching the ice in his glass melt away. Howie Shia marries his graphic illustration style with subtle animation and a haunting soundtrack to conjure up anxiety and foreboding. He used pen and ink on tracing paper and later composited and coloured digitally. This film was made as part of the second edition of the NFB's Hothouse apprenticeship.

title: Eaude
overview: Thea Pratt explores the exhilarating moment of a poetic dive. The movement of the puppet diver is influenced by Norman McLaren, Leni Riefenstahl and Busby Berkeley. Dancing light, frothing oceans, rolling rivers and calm lakes describe in photographic images the diver’s own stream of consciousness. This film was made as part of the second edition of the NFB's Hothouse apprenticeship.

title: Immersion
overview: Megann Reid evokes the solitude and warmth of a bath. Drawn with water colour pencil crayons on frosted acetate, the animation was done under a digital camera. This film was made as part of the second edition of the NFB's Hothouse apprenticeship.

title: Aquasnazz
overview: A marvellous example of extreme animation. Jacob Bauming shows us a whirling dervish of sensory overload, with a tenuous connection to snazzy “aquatics,” using them as a trigger for his wild and manic imagination. This film was made as part of the first edition of the NFB's Hothouse apprenticeship.

title: Submerge: Kami No Yu
overview: A “water poem,” set in a Japanese ofuro hot bath. It explores water as a medium and repository for collective stories and was created in a hybrid new media form using animation, video and split screens. This film was made as part of the first edition of the NFB's Hothouse apprenticeship.

title: Tommy - Lost in the Jungle
overview: Jenny and her baby brother Tommy were born in the Amazon jungle. Their parents, dedicated archeologists, were attacked by tribal warriors. The family was separated, Tommy was carried off by a tribal wise man to be raised among the animals and Jenny was taken to the city by her grandfather.  Years later, once she is grown, Jenny returns to the jungle to find her brother. During the adventure she encounters poachers, fierce creatures, a hidden city, ancient treasure, and finally Tommy.  Together they struggle to escape the dangers of the wild.

title: Panda's Department Store
overview: Young panda of the department store fulfills requests of all special customers.

title: The Good Cat Mimi
overview: A story about a little lazy cat, Mimi, who was bullied by a group of mice because of his laziness and lack of practice. The story is humorous and educational.

title: Vimy-Ridge
overview: In this short animation Damien Hess attempts to connect with the tragedy of the First World War, a conflict that helped define Canada. In this film he uses imagery of the Canadian National Vimy Memorial monument in northern France to summon up names, faces and shadows that are fading from our memory. This film was made as part of the third edition of the NFB's Hothouse apprenticeship.

title: Off Season
overview: Tired park ranger Jude struggles to find her place in her team. Her determination to prove herself leads her to a place where she'll find herself lonelier than ever.

title: The Magnificent Menagerie of Melvin McMelanie
original_title: The Magnificent Menagerie of Melvin McMelanie
overview: A kid and his little traveling show roll into a small train town in 1895 California, only to find it may be harder to earn a penny than originally thought.

title: Nausea
overview: 'Kewpie' manifest themselves as symptoms. A twisting body cannot accept errors.

title: No Body
overview: An autobiographical poetical story reflecting on the city and myself through 3 emotional chapters: excitement, frustration and hope.
production_companies: Central St. Martins College of Art and Design

title: Way of Sylvie
overview: They say that women are great multitaskers and Sylvie definitely is. How does she do it? And does she really manage to do it?

title: Portrait of a Woman
overview: A woman exists as an incomplete form of herself. She goes unknowingly through various stages of life. Suddenly, her real self wakes up and forces her to fight for liberation.

title: The Piece of Tail in the Mouth of the Snake that Bites Its Own Tail
original_title: El trozo de cola en la boca de la serpiente que se muerde la cola
overview: A trip across the cosmos.

title: Unraveled
overview: After a family separation, a young woman failed to provide the emotional support her mother needed. The woman relives this pivotal moment, wishing she could go back and say the things she left unsaid.
production_companies: BAU Centre Universitari d'Arts i Disseny
production_countries: Canada, Italy, Spain, Turkey, United States of America

title: The Next Few Months
overview: The effects of cancer and its subsequent treatments on an individual, and his family.

title: Such a Beautiful Town
overview: In order to confront her unfaithful partner, a young woman embarks on a lonely journey throughout the city, and with each subsequent street it becomes more stifling and unsympathetic.

title: Sura
overview: A high school student. My best friend is pregnant.

title: Airhead!
overview: A child is struggling with a maths problem and his own attention problems. He is being helped by a mother who's slowly but surely losing her patience.

title: The Balloon Catcher
overview: An axe-human tries to get along with a balloon-human in Balloon City.

title: The End
overview: We continue to follow a cowboy on his path into the empty nothingness of the desert, after he rides out of the town he just saved.

title: The Fire Next Time
overview: Rioting spreads as social inequality causes tempers in a struggling community to flare, but the oppressive environment takes on a life of its own as the shadows of the housing estate close in.

title: Egg and Bomb
overview: Henry Waghorn and his father Henry Waghorn Senior run a circus of performing chickens, however the chickens’ real value may be more to do with taste than performance. An offer from Theo Theodolite to join him in a fried chicken outlet has little attraction for the Waghorn family. However Thoe’s daughter Wilga sees a different side to Henry and his training skills and their relationship might have flourished if Henry Senior hadn’t had an unfortunate accident.  Finally the truth of the accident is discovered and the explosive finale sheds new light on the need for better-trained chickens.
production_companies: Independent and General Productions, New Zealand Film Commission

title: My Exercise
original_title: マイ エクササイズ
overview: A boy is doing his exercises with his dog.

title: This Is Pig Meat
overview: I used to be a vegetarian. Pigs used to be my friends. Now, I eat them quite a lot.

title: The Interview
overview: Racial stereotypes and prejudices deprive a highly qualified candidate of a fair interview – and may prevent an employer from hiring the best person for the job.

title: Red Scream
overview: New Zealand’s first CGI short film gives “eyes on the road” a new meaning as a pair of eyeballs drive to a mind-bending purgatory. A collaboration between visual effects man John Sheils and his brother Michael, Scream was shot in early 1991; finally 25 minutes of footage was “brutally” edited down to three, and fulsomely scored by John Gibson. The sly ‘based on true events’ title-card nods to the makers’ ambitions to “treat animation like live action.” In 1994 it screened in NZ cinemas as opener to the ILM wizardry of Jim Carrey hit The Mask, followed by a number of overseas festivals.

title: Gholü
overview: A day in the life of a complicated cannibal.

title: Frustration: When Does a Banknote Start to Burn ?
original_title: Frustration: When Does a Banknote Start to Burn ?
overview: Burn out at the office ? Thousands of photocopies follow each other in this stop motion clip, made for the French post-punk group Frustration.

title: X.Y.U.
overview: A short animated visual madness, where body parts merge and transform through one continuous and strange metamorphosis.

title: Papobo
overview: In the city of Havana in 1964, Papolo, son of a free slave, decides to give a Christmas toy to his sister. He discovers the city and its inhabitants but also the worrying forest. He will get involved in different situations confronting the reality of those times.

title: Eugène
overview: Sydney, 1920. Eugene, 45, is suspected of killing his ex-wife Annie. With superintendent Dick on his trail, he goes on the run. But why if he is, as he claims, innocent ? What if it's something else ? Does he have a secret he wants to hide at all costs ?

title: Unfurnished Room for Rent
overview: A TV with a mind of its own and a man determined to stop it. Nothing is at it seems as the plasticine starts to fly - just don't get too close to the screen. A fantastical clay animation treat.  The jazzy score and trench-coat wearing protagonist in this claymation short promise film noir.  But it soon becomes apparent that the room for rent has something more sinister lurking in it to explain its availability and lack of furnishing.  When the supernatural being attacks the man and his oversized revolver, he has more to worry about than his brain rotting from too much TV.
production_companies: Hot Off The Prescott Productions Ltd, Coupleabucks

title: Decaff
overview: The Film Festival has a bug. The bug is called Decaff. He is short and has an even shorter fuse. He lives in a cinema world and has adventures in all genres. Decaff is the bad-tempered little knot we all have inside us - he does what you wish you could but never would!
production_companies: The Arts Council of New Zealand Toi Aotearoa, NZ on Air, New Zealand Film Commission, James Wallace Productions

title: Orchestra
overview: The harmony performed by players who drawn by lines metamorphose.

title: Сокровенный человек
overview: On October 25, 1917, construction of a new world began in Russia. One of the foremost workers in this construction was the writer Andrei Platonov. But a bright and fair future, his art and literature were seen by everyone in different ways. Its truth became impossible, and the new world was not built in the way it was conceived. Demanding millions of lives for its existence, a brighter future took the life of the writer’s son, who was arrested at the age of fifteen, and then Andrei Platonov himself. The story of the creation and death of the new world in seven days.

title: Naked
overview: A man is accidentally endowed with superpowers. His only desire? For life to go back to normal. He doesn't want to be a superhero, but he can't help it.

title: The Egg
overview: It’s the 18th century in a rural area, and Maria and Fario are going to discover the real values of life, through a tragic but universal event.

title: Christopher Changes His Name
overview: This animated short for children tells the story of Christopher, a little boy who didn't want to be called Christopher anymore. Such a common name! When Aunty Gail from Trinidad tells him a story about a Tiger, Christopher changes his name to Tiger. But then he finds a better name. When he has trouble cashing a birthday cheque, he realizes maybe he should stick with his original name... or maybe not?

title: Jumping Moments
overview: A physical space in a film is always frozen within a small fragment of time - a frame. The artist dynamically explores each space as the frames become combined, transformed, rearranged, and repeated.

title: Milk
overview: This illustrates in a simple way how conventional dairy cows are used. What would happen if people were to be used in the same way?

title: Hoolboom
overview: "Hoolboom" is a film that Arts Toronto commissioned local filmmaker Wrik Mead to make based on his impressions of fellow filmmaker Mike Hoolboom. With some collaboration from Mike, Wrik has produced a film about the body, self-awareness, and the art of film.

title: Moundform
overview: The viewer is swallowed into a body of unrest: abstract organic forms depict tumultuous and vital transformations powered by resilience.

title: Queenie and the All or Nothing Thin King
original_title: Queenie and the All or Nothing Thin King
overview: A mixed media animated piece which utilizes acrylic paint on cels, a camera obscura, stop motion puppetry, shadows, after effects, a scanner, and an exuberant amount of glitter dubbed “random disco flakes”. Originally a zine, Queenie and the All or Nothing Thin King is a short film that follows the internal and unhealthy thought processes of a little felted blobby person named Queenie.

title: Roach
overview: Gregorio has a uniform life. He works in a factory and lives alone. One day a cockroach appears in his pantry and he sees the possibility of changing his life.

title: I'm Not Feeling Very Well
overview: Singing skeletons dream about breaking free from their geometric formation and taking a swim in the great, big, blue sea.

title: Những Chiếc Áo Ấm
overview: Porcupine helps his friend Rabbit sew a shirt
production_companies: Hãng phim hoạt hình Việt Nam

title: Ravines
overview: A short animation film made with Turtle geometry and Perlin noise.

title: Emergency Broadcast
overview: Built at the height of the Cold War to withstand a five-megaton nuclear assault, the Diefenbunker is a massive underground, four-storey, 100,000-square-foot fortress designed and constructed entirely in secrecy in 1959. Inspired by the objects, rooms, and spaces of this Canadian Historic Site, the stop-animation film imagines the beginning of a nuclear war.

title: Ginseng Baby
overview: The spirit ginseng baby helps a teenage tenant to pay his debts to the greedy landlord with a high quality ginseng, but the landlord wants to catch the ginseng baby and present him as a tribute to the emperor.

title: Little Big Bang
overview: Printed manually on a vintage tabletop press using hand-carved linoleum blocks, this very short animation is about a new parent who learns about free expression and the power of letting go. Inspired by the filmmaker’s new baby boy and found sound. Produced as part of the 11th edition of the NFB’s Hothouse apprenticeship.

title: U.F.O.
overview: In this very short animation, an apparition reveals itself through celluloid and transmits vestiges of a forgotten provenance. Have the onlookers interpreted its signs correctly or was the message misunderstood? Inspired by found sound of two people’s discovery of a mysterious event in the sky. Produced as part of the 11th edition of the NFB’s Hothouse apprenticeship.

title: Mindfork
overview: Incorporating found sound of an English language lesson, this very short animation depicts a visual descent into madness triggered by the effort to keep it all together—even when it seems damn near impossible. Produced as part of the 11th edition of the NFB’s Hothouse apprenticeship.

title: the story that might be a dream
overview: Animation by Miryan Paku.

title: Dislocation
overview: Displacement – the enforced departure of people from their homes, typically because of war, persecution, or a natural disaster. This film takes a look at an absurd moment of disbelief and fear. It examines the internal processes that develop and offers a visual depiction of a moment in time of a person forced to fight for his life in a strange land – a moment of displacement.
production_companies: Prime Render Studios, Krupni kadar, Bagan Films, Bonobostudio

title: Pumpers
overview: Inspired by found sound of baby noises, this very short animation takes a good hard look at the bizarre behaviour of people working out in a gym. Produced as part of the 11th edition of the NFB’s Hothouse apprenticeship.

title: a reflection of one's mind
overview: Animation by Kohei Nakaya.

title: Returned Sun
overview: Beautiful screen version of the northern fairy tale tells about the courage of Itte. A brave boy goes through the cold expanse to return the sun. The sun had stolen an evil, insidious and terrible monster and the northern peoples were left without the warmth and light of its rays. title: Idein

The film’s title, Idein, is the ancient Greek word meaning ‘to see’.

title: Computations
overview: Computations is an experimental art film directed and designed by Maxim Zhestkov at Zhestkov Studio.  It speculates a distant future when computation moves from the opaque ‘black boxes’ of our laptops and devices out into the world. Comprised of billions of particles, these dynamic systems sway and undulate in perfect synchronization.  These are benevolent thinking machines that visualize, calculate, and communicate, through coordinated movement and coloured illumination. They are artfully embedded in architecture, perform in space, and demonstrate how each tiny element contributes to the construction of an elegant, emergent whole.

title: Optics

Blending architectural gallery space with computer-generated digital glass sculptures, we encounter animated refractions, chromatic aberrations, colourful reflection and other conditions which are impossible in reality. A series of tests and explorations guides us through different optical conditions of the bright and colourful digital universe.

title: Washi MM
overview: A video documentation of a live performance at LUX in London, 2017. In 2003, I saw Drawings for Expanding Permutation (1969) by the UK artist Mary Martin at a gallery in London. Paul Martin, Mary Martin’s son, kindly gave me a book with pictures of her drawings that I constantly refer to for my Washi Series. This is a set of films and performances, made in response to Martin’s work, that uses the patterned colors of adhesive Japanese washi tape applied directly to clear 16mm film. These patterns are also responsible for the optical soundtracks of the films. In Washi MM three 16mm projectors are used as live instruments of performance to explore rhythmic patterns of color and sound created by the overlays of washi tape.

title: Conversations
overview: Conversations explores the colors of the landscape through the palette of digital color, and is a reconnection with my past narrative films. title: Romany Mirror

title: The Mountain of Flames

Go! plays with the genre of animation and poses a game of semiotics to deconstruct the tropes of children's books and heterosexism.

overview: This animated tale, adapted from the Grimms' "Snow White," tells the story of a beauty and her evil stepmother, whose jealousy is thwarted by the kindness of strangers. A bonus feature, "Snow White / The Wolf and the Seven Little Kids" is included.

title: Granny Samurai, the Monkey King and I
original_title: Granny Samurai, the Monkey King and I
overview: When his next door neighbor, Granny Samurai, defends Sam against the school bully Boris, Sam is first relieved, then alarmed and then highly panicked as she drags him headfirst into an adventure wilder than any book he has ever read. For the Monkey King is sniffing around Sam’s house, looking for a secret weapon to help him in his fight against the human race and soon the school bully will be the smallest problem Sam can possibly imagine.

title: Maryam & Varto
overview: A young teenage Turk is given the difficult mission to save Maryam and her brother Varto, two Armenian children caught up in the 1915 turmoil. They will live an odyssey through Anatolia, sometimes dramatic, sometimes enchanted. This adventure will have unexpected consequences in our day and age where a young woman and her son are going to take a trip from Istanbul to France to meet a grumpy old man who doesn’t want to see them. History’s secrets sometimes hide family secrets where ghosts wait to be reunited.

title: Journey to Yourland
overview: Riki, a 10-year-old boy, runs away from home, following a mysterious emergency signal sent by a shiny stone. It takes Riki to the breathtaking parallel world of “Yourland” where science peacefully coexists with nature.  The shining stone merges with Riki by hiding in his heart. It seems everybody in Yourland is eager to procure this treasure, as it is the core of Yourland’s power and owning it gives a great deal of influence.  Who should Riki share his secret with? His new cheeky friend, Emma? Metal Man, the mighty robot? Tidling, a monkey general?  We accompany Riki on his adventurous journey full of perils, traps and humor, to restore the stone – the “Heart of a Tower” – to its “nest”.

title: The Phaneron
overview: An average man gets a glimpse of solipsism when he discovers the dissonance between his and other people's perception of him after taking pictures at a photo studio.
